name: Sable Hound, Lesser
text_md:
A lean, coal-black hound pads out of the gloom on silent paws. Its eyes are two points of cold grey light, and the shadows behind it seem to lean toward it.

Sable hounds are bred on the shadowed planes as trackers and executioners. A lesser sable hound stands about two feet at the shoulder and weighs some forty pounds. Sable hounds do not speak, but they understand simple commands in Infernal.

special_abilities.name: Shadow Chill
special_abilities.text_md: A creature bitten by a lesser sable hound must succeed on a DC 11 Fortitude save or take 1 point of Dexterity damage as the cold of the shadowed planes seeps into the wound. The save DC is Constitution-based.

special_abilities.name: Shadow Blend
special_abilities.text_md: In any illumination other than bright light, a lesser sable hound can disappear into the shadows, granting it total concealment. Artificial illumination -- even a light or continual flame spell -- does not negate this ability.

skills.text: Hide +7, Listen +5, Move Silently +7, Spot +5, Survival +1 (+3 following tracks)

description_sections.heading: Sable Hound Society
description_sections.text_md: A pack of sable hounds answers to whichever of its members last brought down prey unaided. Handlers exploit this by feeding the pack unevenly.
